_note: Demo bench profiles for local preview and first seed. Replace with real shortlisted candidates from past searches before going live. Surnames, emails and phones are intentionally absent — add them through /bench/admin/ where they stay server-side.

profiles.headline: Runs inbox, calendar and vendor chasing for two founders at once
profiles.summary: Six years supporting owner-operators in construction and professional services. Owns the calendar outright — books, reschedules, and pushes back on meetings that should be an email. Handles vendor follow-up, expense coding, and the weekly ops report. Comfortable being the person who tells the founder what they forgot.

profiles.headline: Books 12–18 qualified meetings a month on cold outbound
profiles.summary: Three years of outbound for US software and services companies. Writes his own sequences, works the phone rather than hiding behind email, and keeps the CRM clean without being asked. Neutral accent, comfortable with C-level gatekeepers.

profiles.headline: Short-form editor — 8 to 12 finished verticals a week
profiles.summary: Five years cutting for agencies and creators. Fast on hook-first vertical edits with captions, sound design and pacing that holds. Also does long-form YouTube and property walkthroughs. Turns a raw folder into a scheduled post without a shot list.

profiles.headline: Ecommerce support — email, chat and refunds without escalation
profiles.summary: Four years handling DTC customer support at volume. Clears 60–90 tickets a day across email and chat, writes macros that actually get used, and de-escalates refund fights before they reach a chargeback. Keeps CSAT above 95%.

profiles.headline: Closes the month in five days and catches what the owner missed
profiles.summary: Seven years of US-facing bookkeeping for service businesses. Full-cycle AP/AR, bank and credit card reconciliation, monthly close, and a P&L the owner can actually read. Has cleaned up two years of neglected books more than once.

profiles.headline: Builds the SOP, then manages the three people running it
profiles.summary: Eight years in operations for agencies and logistics. Documents a process the first time he does it, then hands it off. Has run teams of six. The person you place when the problem is that nothing is written down and everything routes through the owner.

profiles.headline: Runs the content calendar and actually ships the posts
profiles.summary: Four years running social and email for small brands. Plans the month, writes the copy, schedules everything, and reports on what worked. Handles basic design in Canva and briefs editors on video. Does not need to be chased.

profiles.headline: Data entry and CRM cleanup at volume, without drift
profiles.summary: Three years of high-volume data work for real estate and insurance firms. Fast and accurate on entry, dedupe and enrichment, and flags the pattern when the same error keeps appearing rather than just fixing rows.

profiles.headline: Phone-first support for services businesses, UK and US accounts
profiles.summary: Six years in voice support and account management. Handles inbound calls, scheduling and difficult conversations with a neutral accent that clients read as local. Has trained new hires onto the phones twice.

profiles.headline: Real estate and property video — same-day turnaround
profiles.summary: Three years cutting property walkthroughs, agent reels and listing videos. Knows the format cold: pacing, music, lower thirds, branded end cards. Delivers same day on a standard listing edit.

profiles.headline: Chief of staff work — owns the follow-through, not just the calendar
profiles.summary: Nine years supporting executives, the last four as the person who runs the weekly leadership meeting and chases every action item out of it. Manages other assistants, handles confidential matters, and builds the reporting the owner reads on Monday.

profiles.headline: AP/AR and invoicing for agencies that keep forgetting to bill
profiles.summary: Four years of bookkeeping for US agencies and contractors. Owns invoicing end to end — raises them on time, chases what is late, and reconciles as she goes so the month-end is not a scramble.
